Troubleshooting · 42/50 · delivery

Ambiguous version label

Failure signal

A ambiguous version label condition is reported or detected during delivery.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for delivery does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Map every file label to an immutable approval, date, language and deliverable role.

Corrective action

Issue a deterministic version identifier and retire ambiguous aliases in the manifest.

Prevention

Add this verification to the delivery gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
